title: GramSevakCanonicalWeatherRecord
description: Canonical multi-district weather downscaling and observation schema representing normalized Panchayat-level meteorological records for Nashik, Pune, and future districts.

panchayat_id.description: Normalized integer entity identifier for the Gram Panchayat (strictly positive integer).

lgd_code.description: Official Ministry of Panchayati Raj Local Government Directory (LGD) Panchayat Code.

panchayat_name.description: Standardized Gram Panchayat name (Title Case, stripped of whitespace and non-breaking characters).

block_name.description: Standardized administrative Block / Tehsil / Taluka name (Title Case).

district_name.description: Standardized administrative District name (Title Case, e.g. 'Nashik', 'Pune').

panchayat_latitude.description: Geographical latitude of the Gram Panchayat centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84).

panchayat_longitude.description: Geographical longitude of the Gram Panchayat centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.description: Panchayat terrain elevation above mean sea level in meters.

date.description: Validity target date of the daily 24-hour weather observation and forecast (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD).

forecast_issue_date.description: Issuance date of the numerical weather prediction (NWP) model run (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD).

lead_days.description: Forecast lead horizon in integer days: date - forecast_issue_date.

block_forecast_rainfall_mm.description: Regional numerical block-level precipitation forecast issued by IMD/NCMRWF in millimeters.

station_id.description: Identifier of reference Automatic Weather Station (AWS) or Automatic Rain Gauge (ARG).

station_latitude.description: Geographical latitude of reference weather station in decimal degrees (WGS84).

station_longitude.description: Geographical longitude of reference weather station in decimal degrees (WGS84).

station_distance_km.description: Great-circle Haversine distance between Panchayat centroid and reference station in kilometers.

actual_rainfall_mm.description: Ground truth observed 24-hour precipitation in millimeters. Nullable if observation is missing from station.

source_dataset.description: Identifier of the source dataset jurisdiction (e.g. 'nashik', 'pune').

source_file.description: Relative workspace file path of the source dataset from which record originated.

source_row_id.description: Zero-indexed line/record sequence number in the originating source CSV file.

source_panchayat_id.description: Unmodified original string representation of the Panchayat identifier from raw source data.
